programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: When someone dies at a kennel club, McBride tries to keep the accused killer out of jail while finding out who actually committed the murder. It's quite a feat, especially when he keeps getting thrown in the slammer himself!

programme.title: McBride
programme.desc: Kukla, Fran and Ollie is an early American television show using puppets, originally created for children but soon watched by more adults than children. It did not have a script and was entirely ad-libbed.

programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

programme.title: Double Wedding
programme.desc: Twin sisters are keen to find dates ahead of a family party. But in a classic case of mistaken identity, they unknowingly date the same man, and invite him to meet the family on the same day.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Family drama in which a young woman in 1950s America has her strong religious belief challenged by a series of traumatic events. The woman becomes involved with a local pastor, but her faith is tested when he is sent to serve in Korea.

programme.title: The Day of the Triffids
programme.desc: SERIES Sci-fi, United Kingdom 2009, direction: Nick Copus, cast: Dougray Scott, Joely Richardson, Eddie Izzard, Brian Cox In this modern adaptation of John Wyndham's novel, Dougray Scott stars as Dr Bill Masen, who leads the fight against the deadly plants.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. For the lonely Gerta, her only joy is her friendship with a handsome young man, Kai. Then one night, an unknown guest arrives at the inn, dressed in furs and diamonds. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: After Angelica Fanshawe's country noble mother chooses the Catholic faith over the Anglican law of England, her daughter becomes a royal ward of king Charles I, who allows her love marriage to childhood friend and cousin Harry Fanshawe. But social resistance to the king's absolutism, till then maintained by whip in an iron hand, culminates in a parliamentary rebellion, which spills to utter civil war. It means their utter downfall, Harry being executed because his royalist troops capitulated to military genius Oliver Cromwell's while their estate hosts the royal court on permanent flight.

programme.title: The Devil's Whore
programme.desc: The people of the besieged city of Oxford are in a desperate situation. Devastated by the King's brutal betrayal, Angelica has been cast out of court, and finds herself destitute and starving. Meanwhile, divisions are beginning to split the Parliamentarians.

programme.title: Fear the Walking Dead
programme.desc: Teddy (John Glover) brought about his vision of "The End" when he detonated nuclear warheads across the Texas landscape, but it will be up to those who survived to decide what "The Beginning" will look like. And they'll have to do it in a world devoid of light and hope, where the outside air is just as deadly as the walkers they face. The survivors will find out who they really are and what they're really made of. Some will rise to the occasion, some will find new purpose, and some will redefine themselves -- even if it comes at a terrible cost to those they once considered family.

programme.title: Swamp Devil
programme.desc: Melanie Blame returns to their hometown Gibbington because her father, a former sheriff, is wanted for multiple murders. Jimmy Fuller wants to help find her father, and it looks as if something incredibly sinister is responsible for the corpses in Gibbington.

programme.title: Murder 101: The Locked Room Mystery
programme.desc: Murder mystery starring Dick Van Dyke ('Chitty Chitty Bang Bang') as an absent-minded and brilliant criminology professor, and his son Barry Van Dyke as an ex cop turned private investigator. When a New Age spiritualist dies in mysterious circumstances, the professor and his friend, the former cop, investigate.

programme.title: Murder Without Conviction
programme.desc: One day after school, Morgan is talking to one of her friends, and the subject of horseback riding comes up. Morgan has never done it before and thinks it's easy, so she decides to take some lessons. Simply put, she's horrible. Morgan quits, but the jersey won't let her do that. It transforms her into a gymnist. Domnique Dawes reminds her of how she never gives up after only one try at something. Morgan returns as a new person, and finds a little success the second time around. Meanwhile, Coleman, Nick, and Elliot all need a new pair of shoes, but have absolutely no money. Nick's father, Larry, offers them a job at his office, ""Lighter than Air"". While there, Coleman finds some really cool clothes, Elliot finds office supplies, and Nick builds an enorous sandwich. Obviously, they didn't do their job. However, they meet Jim Harbaugh, star quarterback for the San Diego Chargers (at the time) and Larry lets the three each get a pair of new shoes for no apparent reason.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: Mystery Woman
programme.desc: Amicably divorced from art gallery keeper Elliot McCallister, Samantha Kinsey (who always dreamed of being a detective like her prosecutor's office friend, Cassie,) inherits her uncle's mystery-specialized bookshop. It comes with a mysterious clerk, presumed retired spy Ian Philby. Her former literature professor and true crime author Jack Stenning's adopted daughter with psychic abilities, Tracy, bemoans her father's dismissal of her fear of his writing a book about her nightmarish vision of a ten-year-old murder, which reveals a witness survived. At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 1: Mystery Weekend
programme.desc: When the book shop hosts a mystery weekend, recluse hit author Clare Beckman announces her retirement, DA Cassie is hit by what may well be a failed attempt. Charming new lawyer Scott Tyler dates both friends. The weapon was registered by oldest attending local Dorothy, who rather risks arrest by the chief then accepting help or disclosing the truth, including about her ex Derek. Later, Clare mysteriously dumps fiancee Grant and dies from bee poison, which only works due to her allergy which few people knew about.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 2: Snapshot
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Samantha Kinsey's latest case has her trying to figure out who killed her best friend Barbara after she was left out of her family's will and every one of the family members become suspects.

programme.title: Earthsea
programme.desc: Based on the eponymous series of books by Ursula K. LeGuin, Earthsea centers on a young man whose destiny lies in his own hands; a man with the power to become the greatest sorcerer his world has ever known. The youthful protagonist, Ged, realises he possesses endless magical powers, and embarks on an adventure to master his mystical abilities. His world needs him; the evil ruler of Earthsea, King Tygath, wants to govern the land with an iron fist, but Ged must learn to harness his powers before he can save his people. Two-part fantasy adventure series.

The monsters in an old non released movie come out of the movie and Tim and his friends in the real world and the movie must find a way to stop the monsters. The movie has bullies, geeks, parents, a love intrest, et cetera.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Mysterious Island
programme.desc: The free adaptation of Jules Verne's adventure novel takes us to a mysterious island in the Pacific, which seems to be an ideal refuge for deserters on the run. Union captain Cyrus Smith (Kyle MacLachlan), African-American slave Neb (Omar Gooding), widowed sister Jane (Gabrielle Anwar) and her teenage daughter Helen (Danielle Calvert) and two desperate Confederate soldiers already had their teeth full of civil war in their homeland and issued on an adventurous balloon flight into the unknown. They feel they have just found the Promised Land. However, their dream of freedom did not last long. At first glance, the island is inhabited by monsters that give them nothing, and it seems that their only refuge and rescue may be Captain Nemo (Patrick Stewart) and his submarine. The sooner they understand this, the higher their chances of survival ...

programme.desc: Prof. Lehman discovers in his Mexican observatory earth is about to be hit by asteroid 114 Kassandra, thrice the size of Mt. Everest, more than the meteor which ended the dinosaur age, preceded by a minor meteor shower. Alas on the road back he dies in a car crash. His assistant Imogen has a hard time getting his data home, where the military HQ is inaptly advised by Dr. Nate Chetwyn. LAPD detective Jack Crowe is set up for his wife's murder by his dirty ex-partner Calvin Stark, who kidnaps his daughter Jenny, determined to make him suffer. That includes Jack's dad, the sheriff in home town Taft, trying to keep order and organize help as the first debris hits cause damage. Life soon breaks down worldwide, in panic and looting after numerous hits. The military uses its rocket arsenal.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: The military naively thinks it's over after 3 quiet hours with a body count over 22,000 worldwide. Imogen continuous her perilous journey, slowly, and warns them Daniel's calculations were off too in mass, Kassandra broke and the largest part is left. The new debris shower even hits the HQ, all satellite communications go down. The only hope is observing from a space mission, by Morse over ground aerials. The US arsenal being nearly exhausted, the Chinese join, the Russians must be tricked. Vindictive Calvin Stark escapes and gets hold of Jenny, so Jack pursues them all his murderous way to Taft. There his dad the sheriff must control panic after the nuclear power station is hit, and help them face Calvin. Michael gets in even more danger because of ma's foolish instructions, dad and a fireman heroically come to the rescue.

They are mobile, carnivorous, intelligent, and wreak havoc wherever they go. Starring Joely Richardson, Brian Cox, Vanessa Redgrave and Eddie Izzard.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 3: Sing Me A Murder
programme.desc: Murder is something to sing about when Mystery Woman Samantha Kinsey-an expert in pulp fiction, and increasingly proficient when it comes to real-life crime-untangles a record-breaking murder. Mystery Woman bookshop owner, Samantha Kinsey, has offered to host a charity concert for a once-famous folk-rock trio out to recapture their old fame flame. But sweet success hits the ultimate sour note when the band's promoter is found murdered in his hotel room. Sam and her partner in crime, Philby, investigate, digging up deadly secrets of private indiscretions, professional greed, and personal vengeance that put a twisted spin on fame and fortune-and bring a whole new meaning to a Top Ten hit.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 4: Vision Of A Murder
programme.desc: Sam lands a job photographing a new spa in Southern California for their brochure and brings her best friend Cassie along to enjoy some pampering. When one of the guests staying at the upscale retreat turns up dead, Sam is once again on the trail of a murderer. As the investigation progresses, Sam uncovers a scam that the spa Dr was testing unapproved drugs on the patrons.. filler implants, etc. without the patients' informed consent.

programme.title: The Pleasure of Your Company
programme.desc: THE NEXT GIRL I SEE is a comedy that shows us that love has nothing to do with perfection. After losing the woman of his dreams, Anderson is convinced he'll never fall in love again. But at the urging of his best friend, he spontaneously proposes to a dissatisfied waitress named Katie and an innocent dare evolves into the kind of love that both have been looking for all along.

programme.title: The King and Queen of Moonlight Bay
programme.desc: 17-year-old Alison embarks on a mission: to find the father who abandoned her family when she was five years old, try to understand the past, and reestablish a relationship with the stranger she has never forgotten.

programme.title: The Yeltsin Project
programme.desc: Russian political elite hires American consultants to help with President Yeltsin's re-election campaign when his approval rating is down to single digits.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: A young Venetian, Marco is abandoned by his father for the merchant Silk Road in the hands of the Mongolian emperor, Kublai Khan, who is at war with China. Kublai recognizes Marco's observation skills, and teaches him the Mongolian culture.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Historical drama series based on the escapades of Marco Polo: an infamous merchant-turned-explorer who travelled through Asia in the 13th century. Finding himself in the upper echelons of the Mongol Empire, the Venice-born Marco Polo embarks on a series of adventures in a world filled with war, revenge, tough decisions, love, loyalty, and betrayal. Starring Lorenzo Richelmy as Marco Polo.

At a party in his home to present the new book, Jack is murdered by a surprise guest who brought a noose to stage a suicide and took evidence from the scene. Jack's estranged son Tom and his boss Lt. Robert Hawke investigate but rule suicide. Although his beneficiary, and claiming she loved Jack despite serial adultery, widow Mary asks the bookstore's would-be-sleuths to prove it a murder and solve it. Shortly after, Sam is the target of a break-in and sabotage.

programme.title: Ordinary Miracles
programme.desc: Drama with Jaclyn Smith. A kindhearted judge agrees to take in a juvenile delinquent, hoping to help the youngster rehabilitate and face her troubled past.

programme.title: What I Did for Love
programme.desc: Call him a city slicker. Call him a tenderfoot. But don't call him a member of the family yet. Rising L.A. lawyer James White is going home for the holidays with his fiancée, Sadie Ryder, to finally meet her family in rural Pine Gap. After blundering through a bad first impression, James attempts to win over Sadie's lawyer-loathing father Karl by pretending to be a horse-riding, hay-baling, game-hunting, seasoned square dancer. But a pair of worn jeans and a ten-gallon hat don't make a cowboy, and it's going to take more than mere posturing to charm Mr. Ryder...in fact, it just may take a miracle.

programme.title: A Place Called Home
programme.desc: Tula Jetters (Ann Margret) is a stubborn widow who still mourns the death of her husband from years ago called "The Captain." She lives alone in a big beautiful home by a lake, but her independence may be threatened by the reality of her diminished vision. She has resisted change, including seeing an eye specialist. Her late husband's niece Billie (Hunter Tylo) and nephew Dave (Sean O'Bryan) have a real estate agency and are now pressuring her to go into assisted living. They have dreams of using her land to make a killing in a big land development. They get a county social worker Jan (Rebecca McFarland) involved in evaluating her independence. Into this mix drops a drifter Henry (Matthew Settle) and his young daughter Cali (Shailene Woodley). Restless Henry becomes a handyman while Cali dreams of having a home here.

programme.title: Back to You and Me
programme.desc: After befriending a patient and then losing her to cancer, Dr. Sydney Ludwick decides to take some long-needed time off to reevaluate her life. Persuaded by a friend to attend her 20th high school reunion, Syd halfheartedly returns to her small hometown where, after years of estrangement, she finally confronts her mother about the past and faces the love she left behind.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. For the lonely Gerta, her only joy is her friendship with a handsome young man, Kai. Then one night, an unknown guest arrives at the inn, dressed in furs and diamonds. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: Snow Queen
programme.desc: After the tragic death of her mother, Gerta and her father continue to run the small inn they call home. For the lonely Gerta, her only joy is her friendship with a handsome young man, Kai. Then one night, an unknown guest arrives at the inn, dressed in furs and diamonds. The next day, she disappears along with Kai.

programme.title: Stranded
programme.desc: David Robinson is being shipped off to a penal colony. His wife and kids are allowed to accompany him. A storm strikes the ship and the family (save for one son, Jacob) are trapped below deck. Jacob is raised by pirates, and the family gets out of the boat and on to land, salvaging as much as they can from the boat, including dogs, chickens, and muskets. They learn to survive and build a shelter on land. Then, Jacob's pirates kidnap Emily, the daughter of a sea-captain. She escapes onto the island and becomes a love interest with Fritz and Ernst. Jacob is reunited with his family during a battle with the pirates over Emily, and she is returned to her father. In the end, the family goes their own ways, some staying on the island, some going home.

programme.title: Mayflower Madam
programme.desc: Inspired by the explosive sex-for-sale scandal that rocked Manhattan in 1984, the infamous Sydney Biddle Barrows, a driven young socialite, opens an exclusive escort service catering to the wealthy and affluent. From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: College professor J.T. Neumeyer is visiting his wife's grave with his daughter, Jesse, on the anniversary of her death. Suddenly, out of nowhere, a mysterious briefcase appears. Inside, J.T. finds the details of and newspaper clippings about his own murder, which is, supposedly, going to happen at the stroke of midnight in five days.

programme.title: 5ive Days to Midnight
programme.desc: Physics professor J.T. Neumeyer finds a briefcase that contains a file predicting his own murder in five days.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.title: Selling Innocence
programme.desc: Mia Sampson (Sarah Lind), an unpopular girl, is approached at the mall one day to become a model. Even though she thinks modeling is shallow, she thinks it will be a better way to earn money than working for a sushi restaurant and goes to the agency. She poses for photographs which are to be displayed on an Internet website for "members only," supposedly so she can be scouted for other modeling jobs. As Mia's membership begins to go up, she begins feeling uncomfortable and also receives disturbing messages from a subscriber known as Gabriel. However, she continues to take shots and even participates in live video chats with the gentlemen of the site. Too late, Mia realizes that she is working for a pornography site and goes to a group called webwatch to uncover the operation. However, since the agency isn't doing anything illegal, the police can't do anything.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Valensijos „Basket“ - Atėnų „Panatinaikos“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed with Danny Trejo
programme.desc: Shady Secrets. Some secrets refuse to stay buried. Whether it's illicit cargo in a frozen lake, a stolen masterpiece worth millions, or a brothel hidden in the shadow of the Capitol - the truth always resurfaces.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Forged in Fire
programme.desc: Forged in Fire features world-class bladesmiths competing against each other to create some of the most iconic edged weapons from history. In each episode, four of the best bladesmiths in the country will come together to put both their skills and reputations on the line. Whether they are making a Japanese katana, a medieval broadsword, or an ancient throwing blade like the chakram, the weapons they forge will be fully functional and lethal works of art and war. The unique histories contained within each weapon will be creatively told during the forging process and the final weapons themselves will be assessed and ruthlessly tested by our panel of expert judges. These dynamic and explosive tests will be individually designed to push the weapons to their absolute limit. One by one, the bladesmiths will be eliminated until only one remains to be crowned the champion.

From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Forged in Fire
programme.desc: Forged in Fire features world-class bladesmiths competing against each other to create some of the most iconic edged weapons from history. In each episode, four of the best bladesmiths in the country will come together to put both their skills and reputations on the line. Whether they are making a Japanese katana, a medieval broadsword, or an ancient throwing blade like the chakram, the weapons they forge will be fully functional and lethal works of art and war. The unique histories contained within each weapon will be creatively told during the forging process and the final weapons themselves will be assessed and ruthlessly tested by our panel of expert judges. These dynamic and explosive tests will be individually designed to push the weapons to their absolute limit. One by one, the bladesmiths will be eliminated until only one remains to be crowned the champion.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: Is a video showing a strange formation of flickering lights the latest proof that Houston is a UFO hotspot? What is this mysterious humanoid creature caught on camera in an abandoned attic? Was the Government caught transporting Alien technology at a top-secret military base? And why the latest Provo Utah Bigfoot sighting seems to put the "Big" in Bigfoot. Tony Harris and his team of experts examine the clues and decide the validity of what we're seeing.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?".

programme.title: Ancient Aliens: Origins
programme.desc: For thousands of years, secret societies are said to have guarded hidden knowledge of otherworldly origin. Could the so-called gods who shared these secrets have been visitors from the stars, as Ancient Astronaut Theorists contend?

programme.title: Mountain Men
programme.desc: There are men in America who must still make their living off the land; hunting and trapping to provide for their families. They are MOUNTAIN MEN. Their very survival is predicated on utilizing ancient skills perfected over hundreds of years. This series features a variety of men from Appalachia to the Rocky Mountains to Alaska and follows them as they race against winter to obtain the sustenance and money needed to make it through the coldest months of the year. Eustace Conway lives deep in the mountains of North Carolina on the "Turtle Bay Reserve." He moved here two decades ago in search of a more "truthful" existence. In the years since, he's built a home, and survived by hunting, fishing and raising animals. Tom Orr lives with his wife on the Yaak River in Montana. He is 100 miles from the nearest town, a place he hasn't ventured to in 10 years. John is a trapper by trade and to prepare for winter, he must earn enough money to obtain the supplies he needs. Marty Meierotto, his wife Dominique and their daughter Noah live in the small Alaskan town of Two Rivers. Every month, Marty pilots his bi-plane, traveling into the bush in search of the wolverine and lynx pelts he needs to make a living. While he's on the Black River, he must hunt moose and caribou to survive in the wilderness. Together, they represent America's true MOUNTAIN MEN.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The Proof Is Out There
programme.desc: The world's most mysterious videos, photos, and audio recordings, and uses the best technology and experts to render a credible verdict. Each episode analyzes and passes verdicts on several seemingly impossible things "caught on film" including giant beasts, UFOS, apocalyptic sounds, hairy humans, alleged mutants from the deep, conspiracies, and many other cases. Host and veteran journalist Tony Harris takes nothing for granted in a quest for answers, tracking down eyewitnesses, putting each photo or film through a battery of tests, calling out the hoaxes, and highlighting the most credible evidence in an attempt to better understand our world.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: Octopuses were always thought to be natures ultimate loners, preferring their own company. The truth is they have secret social lives. From moms to be hanging out in the deep in their hundreds to an octopus capable of coworking with another species. These aliens of nature are more sociable than ever imagined.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Winter of the Bear
programme.desc: In the forests of northern Finland, survival is a race against the seasons. For a mother brown bear, life between winters is a relentless battle as a single mother. She wakes from hibernation, thin and weary, to guide cubs through a fleeting summer. They need food, and she'll teach them everything, not least of all, avoiding dangerous males during mating season and facing wolves in a deadly fight for food. Every day counts in these forests. When winter returns, only the strong and the wise will endure this wild, unforgiving land.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Instead of providing in-depth examinations of the fauna of the continent of Africa, this nature series alternatively focuses on the hostile and unforgiving landscapes that the animals have to survive in. Africa is home to some of the most extreme and diverse environments on the planet, from arid deserts to lush rainforests, mountainous peaks to mighty river and lake systems, savannah grasslands to rugged coastline. This show explores these different regions and documents how the plants and creatures that inhabit them endure places where there are few resources of food and water or where competition is rife and life-threatening. The unique demands placed on these plants and animals have resulted in the development of incredibly resilient species that remain successful against all the odds.

programme.title: Wild Vietnam
programme.desc: Travel to southern Vietnam's tropical habitats, home to gibbons and playful macaques, green sea turtles, and Asian black bears. Reintroduced Siamese crocodiles roam the Bau Sau wetlands. The vast Mekong Delta boasts small-clawed otters and thousands of migrating birds, from openbill storks to Oriental darters.

Though more renowned for its pristine beaches and luscious palms, Hawaii is a wild and untamed area of brutal, natural beauty. programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: From Sri Lanka to Indonesia and Japan, Asia's wild islands teem with some of the world's wildest creatures. Some arrived by sea, others crossed land bridges when sea levels were lower. But all of them have had to adapt in fascinating ways to their isolated lives. Discover how creatures from the slow loris to the komodo dragon, the mugger crocodile to the proboscis monkey have adapted to island life.

programme.title: Asia's Wild Secrets
programme.desc: Tigers cool off in it, fight over it and lie in wait for prey on its edges. Elephants, rhinos and buffalo guzzle it, submerge in it, depend on it. The great hornbill and lion tailed macaques depends on it too, to create forests big enough to sustain them. Hokkaido's brow bears wouldn't survive without it. Whether it comes from the monsoon, from Himalayan meltwater, the tides or snow, ever animal in Asia has a story to tell about water.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bees
programme.desc: National Geographic Explorer Bertie Gregory explores the extraordinary lives of bees — among the planet's most important animals. Over three years, special cameras opened a rare window into a single hive, revealing their hidden world. But with more than 20,000 bee species pollinating one-third of the world's food, this series uncovers their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Delve beneath the surface of the largest habitat on Earth - our oceans - to uncover a world of extraordinary extremes from crushing depths to stormy coasts and vast blue deserts to crowded reefs. Oceans are dynamic environments where animals must adapt to life of constant change. Discover how seals fend off sharks; how turtles risk their lives to create their next generation; and how ingenious orca fight to survive in the face of ever-increasing competition.

programme.title: Queens
programme.desc: The Congo Forest in Central Africa is home to a secretive animal we still know very little about. Bonobos are one of our closest relatives, but in their society it's females who rule. She must make new friends and impress the alpha female before she can truly fit in.

programme.title: Queens
programme.desc: The Ethiopian Mountain world is ruled by two very different queens, but both mothers raising daughters. programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces

Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: She overthrew the preceding ruler of North Clan in an unprecedented take-over, fighting her way up from a lowly rank to matriarch. She is both a ruthless battle commander, leading her clan in warfare against rivals and adversaries like lion, and devoted guardian to her clan and parent to her offspring.

programme.title: Wild Hunters
programme.desc: Embark on a spectacular journey around the world in search of nature's deadliest predators. See how mammals, insects, fish, and birds fight for survival using a fascinating combination of hunting strategies.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: In the wild, animals face life or death battles every day, from escaping deadly predators to fighting off fierce rivals. Sometimes brute force isn't enough to prevail. Survival can depend on death-defying acrobatics, secret senses and hidden weapons - the extraordinary superpowers that help animals survive.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: After losing his mother and sister at one year old, he taught himself to hunt, but now has to deal with his other thieving relatives. He's survived this long in spite of difficulty, and knocks down all stereotypes as he is not only social, but family oriented.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: She leads the formidable Sausage Tree Pride, an ensemble of buffalo-slaying huntresses. That is, until the migration crosses their prime domain and they demonstrate ultimate adaptability and switch prey species. But the pride has been compromised after a split-away group left their ranks and now she must muster her troupe to excel at motherhood while male coalitions complicate dynamics all around them.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: Identified by her burnt orange gaze, she leads a pride of five closely-related lionesses and their six offspring. They overcome every challenge as a precision unit: the gauntlet of the buffalo hunt or the upheaval of new males that could either decimate the prides ranks or offer her the chance to finally mother cubs. But desperate drought and crippling disease push the sisterhood to the absolute brink of survival.

programme.title: Predator Bloodlines
programme.desc: To see them stride across the Mara is a spectacle indeed. An undeniable band-of-brothers, these males significantly enhance their odds of survival against the larger super-predators of the savanna, lions and hyenas, and prove an attractive dynamic to the female spotted athletes also forging a living on the plains. But no partnership comes without its challenges and leadership amongst the group is not a done deal either.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Phil Breslin, third generation Indigenous educator, biologist and adventurer is on a quest to reveal some of the strangest and most specialised animal adaptations on the planet. Focusing on Australia's incredibly varied landscapes and environments, Phil yarns with First Nations people about habitats, traverses deserts, dives in the ocean's depths and uses science to identify Australia's ultimate animal survivors.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Africa is a land sculpted by time where animals have evolved complex weapons to arm them in the battle to live another day. An elephant's tusks can defend, or attack. An octopus uses camouflage to find food, or hide from an enemy. A Cape Fur Seal's speed and agility are valuable tools to catch a penguin, but ineffectual against a Great White Shark. A single hippopotamus holds a pride of twelve lions at bay with his sheer bulk, but backs down when faced with the piercing teeth of another hippo. With lethal weapons wielded by fearsome predators and prey, animals walk a precarious path, here among Africa's Deadliest.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Docs at Critter Fixer get up close and personal with venomous snakes, help a dog whose face droops, and send a diabetic canine on the road to recovery. Also visiting the clinic are a dove with labored breathing, a hairless cat with a lump, and a couple ferrets with a flea problem. Finally, Dr. Hodges goes on a hunt for a missing testicle, and Dr. Ferguson and the team make a house-call for an ornery pot-bellied pig.

programme.title: Critter Fixers: Country Vets: Compilations
programme.desc: The Docs at Critter Fixer work nose-to-toes on a variety of animals, including a goose with an injured leg, a bearded dragon with an upset tummy, a rat with a large lump on its face, and a puppy with a life-threatening virus. They also help a dog with pyometra, a puppy with road rash, a rabbit with ear mites, and a pot-bellied pig with an overgrown tusk!

programme.title: Dora the Explorer
programme.desc: Dora is an interactive animated series about the cheerful and enterprising young girl Dora who likes to travel through the jungle of South America with her little monkey Boots. Her father and mother live in the jungle. Dora is curious of everything and wants to know about animals, flowers and plants of the forest. When she travels she always take with her a little back with survival equipment and a singing map.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

But that doesn't stop Mr. Krabs from finding out what's going on at the party-he sends his #1 employee SpongeBob to be his undercover spy! The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Adventures of Kid Danger
programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. His cool part time gig as Kid Danger, takes him on out of this world adventures as the sidekick-in-training to famous superhero Captain Man. They go on bizarre and crazy travels, battling criminals and villains that try to attack his hometown and Captain Man himself. Meanwhile at home, Henry has to stay in hiding, keeping his sidekick job as a secret from his best friends, Charlotte and Jasper, and little sister Piper. What exciting adventures will Kid Danger get up to with Captain Man and will be he be able to hide his alter ego from his friends and family?

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.desc: Coverage of Italy's top-flight football league.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: English Football League Championship
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. programme.title: Il professore e il pinguino
programme.desc: Un insegnante di inglese disilluso si reca in Argentina nel 1976 per insegnare. Si trova di fronte a una classe di ragazzi turbolenti e a un Paese nel caos. Quando salva un pinguino da una spiaggia inquinata dal petrolio, tutto cambia.

programme.title: C'e' Ancora Domani
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Paola Cortellesi, anche protagonista, entrato nella storia del cinema italiano. Roma,1946: Delia ha accettato la sua vita ma spera in un futuro migliore per la figlia.

programme.title: L'ultimo dei Mohicani
programme.desc: Un Oscar all'epica avventura di Michael Mann con Daniel Day-Lewis. Nordamerica, 1700: durante le guerre coloniali, un indiano salva la vita alle figlie di un comandante inglese.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Southpaw - L'ultima sfida
programme.desc: Avvincente dramma sul mondo della boxe con Jack Gyllenhaal e Rachel McAdams. Caduto in disgrazia dopo un incidente, un pugile deve tornare sul ring per ottenere la custodia della figlia.

programme.title: La ricerca della felicità
programme.desc: Esordio hollywoodiano per Gabriele Muccino che dirige Will Smith in un film emozionante. San Francisco, anni 80: un uomo disperato trova la forza di ricominciare grazie a suo figlio.

programme.title: È stato tutto bello - Storia di Paolino e Pablito
programme.desc: Walter Veltroni racconta in un documentario la vita e la carriera di Paolo Rossi, uno degli eroi della nazionale italiana che trionfo' ai Mondiali di calcio del 1982.

programme.title: E' stato il figlio
programme.desc: Toni Servillo in una vicenda grottesca di Daniele Cipri'. Dopo la morte della figlia, una famiglia palermitana spende il risarcimento in una Mercedes. L'automobile segnera' la loro rovina.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: Questo O Quello - Cinema E Serie Aprile
programme.desc: Cinema E Serie Aprile - Ep269 Questo O Quello - Cinema E Serie Aprile - Questo O Quello - Cinema E Serie Aprile.

programme.title: Il traditore
programme.desc: Marco Bellocchio dirige Pierfrancesco Favino nella biografia del 'boss dei due mondi', Tommaso Buscetta, il primo pentito della mafia, che testimonio' nel maxiprocesso contro Cosa Nostra.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Itaca. Il Ritorno
programme.desc: Il poema omerico nella rilettura di Uberto Pasolini che mette in scena il ritorno di Ulisse nella sua Itaca dopo 20 anni di lontananza, ma il suo regno è profondamente cambiato ed è minacciato dai Proci.

programme.title: C'era una volta a... Hollywood
programme.desc: Oscar a Brad Pitt nel film di Quentin Tarantino con Leonardo DiCaprio e Margot Robbie. 1969: le vicende di Sharon Tate si intrecciano con quelle di un attore in declino e del suo stuntman.

programme.title: Fuga per la vittoria
programme.desc: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine e Pele' nel cult di John Huston. I prigionieri di un lager sfidano i soldati nazisti in una partita di calcio sperando di approfittarne per evadere.

programme.title: Barry Seal - Una storia americana
programme.desc: Tom Cruise e Domhnall Gleeson in un action tratto da una storia vera. Un pilota accusato di narcotraffico viene reclutato dalla Cia per svolgere missioni sotto copertura in Centro America.

programme.title: Mon Crime - La colpevole sono io
programme.desc: François Ozon dirige una commedia a tinte gialle nella Parigi degli anni 30. Una giovane aspirante attrice viene accusata dell'omicidio di un famoso produttore. Nel cast Isabelle Huppert.

programme.title: Il colore della libertà
programme.desc: Biopic prodotto da Spike Lee. 1961: Bob Zellner, studente universitario dell'Alabama e nipote di un membro del Ku Klux Klan, decide di schierarsi in difesa dei diritti degli afroamericani.

programme.title: Aprile
programme.desc: Nanni Moretti dirige e interpreta una commedia pungente che e' insieme opera autobiografica e resoconto critico delle vicende politiche, dalla primavera del 1994 all’estate del 1997.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Tom Hanks nel terzo thriller tratto dal bestseller di Dan Brown. Firenze: il professor Langdon deve fermare un folle scienziato ossessionato dall'inferno di Dante.

programme.title: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: Paul Walker e Vin Diesel nel primo entusiasmante capitolo della saga. Un agente di Los Angeles si infiltra nel mondo delle corse clandestine per smascherare una banda di rapinatori.

programme.title: 2 Fast 2 Furious
programme.desc: John Singleton dirige Paul Walker nel primo sequel della saga. Un ex poliziotto si infiltra sotto falsa identita' nella gang di un narcotrafficante con l'obiettivo di incastrarlo.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 5
programme.desc: Paul Walker, Vin Diesel e Dwayne Johnson nel quinto capitolo della saga action. Brasile: Brian e Dominic riuniscono il team per organizzare un ultimo colpo (USA 2011).

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della saga action con Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, 'The Rock' e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic e Brian riuniscono la vecchia squadra per contrastare una banda di piloti criminali.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Vin Diesel, 'The Rock', Jason Statham e il compianto Paul Walker nel settimo capitolo della saga. Dominic e compagni devono difendersi da un killer deciso a vendicare il fratello.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 8
programme.desc: Tornano i muscoli e i motori della saga blockbuster in un iperbolico ottavo capitolo che schiera Vin Diesel, Jason Statham, Dwayne Johnson, Kurt Russell e il premio Oscar Charlize Theron. Un'affascinante dark lady, Cipher, usa l'arma del ricatto e della seduzione per convincere Dominique Toretto a tradire i suoi amici e a lavorare per lei. Dom entra cosi' nel mondo del terrorismo internazionale: la prima missione, a Berlino, lo vedra' impossessarsi di un ordigno a spese dell'ex compagno di squadra Hobbes. e' solo il punto di partenza di un giro intorno al mondo ad alto tasso di pericolosita'.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Hobbs & Shaw
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Jason Statham e Idris Elba nel primo spin-off della saga. Gli agenti Hobbs e Shaw si alleano per fermare un terrorista che minaccia di decimare la razza umana con un virus.

programme.desc: Emozionante animazione targata DreamWorks diretta da Chris Sanders e candidata a 3 Oscar. Precipitato su un'isola, un robot viene incidentalmente attivato dalla fauna locale.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas
programme.desc: Luca Argentero e il cast presentano l'Avvocato Ligas, penalista anticonvenzionale sempre pronto a rischiare pur di vincere una causa.

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini
programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: Rosanero
programme.desc: Andrea Porporati dirige Salvatore Esposito in una commedia per tutta la famiglia targata Sky Original. Al risveglio dal coma, una bambina si ritrova nel corpo di un boss e viceversa.

programme.title: Come far litigare mamma e papà
programme.desc: Brillante commedia per tutta la famiglia con Giampaolo Morelli e Carolina Crescentini. Invidioso dei compagni di classe, Gabriele elabora un piano per far separare i suoi genitori.

programme.title: I Puffi - Il film
programme.desc: Travolgente avventura d'animazione insieme alle piccole e amatissime creature blu nate dalla matita del fumettista Peyo, con le voci di Paolo Bonolis e Luca Laurenti.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit: La maledizione del coniglio mannaro
programme.desc: Oscar come miglior film d'animazione per una strabiliante avventura. Wallace e Gromit devono fermare un enorme e vorace coniglio che sta per rovinare la fiera dell'ortaggio gigante (GBR 2005).

programme.title: Il giorno piu' bello del mondo
programme.desc: Commedia di grande successo per tutta la famiglia diretta e interpretata da Alessandro Siani. Un impresario teatrale deve difendere un bambino speciale da un team di scienziati.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: I serpenti a sonagli spuntano a centinaia, i picchi si danno da fare per immagazzinare cibo e le gru si radunano a centinaia durante la loro secolare migrazione.

programme.title: The Americas
programme.desc: La più grande foresta pluviale del pianeta: qui gli alberi ospitano scimmie e aquile, le acque lontre giganti, cuccioli di tartaruga e caimani.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Avventure fantasy per Robin Williams. Due ragazzi rimangono intrappolati nei pericolosi labirinti di un gioco da tavolo e affrontano ogni tipo di insidia per liberarsi.

programme.title: Genitori vs Influencer
programme.desc: Fabio Volo, Ginevra Francesconi e Giulia De Lellis nella commedia Sky Original di Michela Andreozzi. Un prof si scontra con la figlia teenager per colpa dei social... ma diventa influencer.

programme.title: La vigilia di Natale nel Paese delle Meraviglie
programme.desc: La magia del Natale incontra il mondo di "Alice nel paese delle meraviglie" in un'animazione musicale targata Sky Original.

programme.title: La Befana vien di notte II - Le origini
programme.desc: Prequel con Monica Bellucci, Fabio De Luigi e Zoe Massenti tra avventure e incantesimi. Una giovane orfana entra in conflitto con un avido barone, ma una strega gentile la salvera'.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.title: Rosanero
programme.desc: Andrea Porporati dirige Salvatore Esposito in una commedia per tutta la famiglia targata Sky Original. Al risveglio dal coma, una bambina si ritrova nel corpo di un boss e viceversa.

programme.title: The Americas

programme.title: The Americas

programme.title: Genitori vs Influencer

programme.title: The Portable Door
programme.desc: Dai libri fantasy di Tom Hol, film Sky Original con Christoph Waltz, Sam Neill e Patrick Gibson. Londra: due tirocinanti scoprono che i loro capi vogliono sabotare il mondo della magia.

programme.title: Il principe dimenticato
programme.desc: Omar Sy in un'estrosa commedia onirica di Michel Hazanavicius. Djibi si trasforma ogni notte nell'eroe dei sogni di sua figlia. Finche' lei, crescendo, non mutera' il suo immaginario.

programme.title: Sinbad - La leggenda dei sette mari
programme.desc: Il magico mondo del leggendario pirata in un gioiello d'animazione targato Dreamworks. Sinbad viene ingiustamente accusato del furto dell'inestimabile 'Libro della Pace'. Gli viene data la possibilità di ritrovarlo, anche per salvare la vita dell'amico Proteo ma il focoso marinaio non ne ha tanta voglia: meglio andare alle Isole Fiji, in cerca di sole e divertimento_ Ma a vigilare sulla missione c'è la coraggiosa Marina... Nella versione originale le voci di Sinbad e Marina sono di Brad Pitt e Catherine Zeta-Jones, doppiate in italiano da Pino Insegno e Claudia Gerini.

programme.title: Baby Boss
programme.desc: Dal regista di "Madagascar" una esilarante pellicola d'animazione della DreamWorks candidata agli Oscar 2018. L'arrivo di un fratellino dispotico stravolge la vita del giovane Tim.

programme.title: Baby Boss 2 - Affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Sequel dell'animazione di successo targata Dreamworks. Tim e Ted sono diventati adulti e si sono allontanati l'uno dall'altro, finche' una missione top secret non li costringe a riunirsi.

programme.title: La Piccola Amelie
programme.desc: Amélie è una bambina belga nata in Giappone. Grazie al suo amico, Nishio San, il mondo è pieno di avventure e scoperte. Il giorno del suo terzo compleanno, un evento cambia il corso della sua vita.

programme.title: Unicorni
programme.desc: Blu è un bambino che sogna di interpretare la Sirenetta. Suo padre Lucio non sa come affrontare le richieste del figlio mentre sua moglie, Elena, tende ad assecondare le richieste di Blu. Il gruppo di "Genitori Unicorni" sostiene la famiglia.

programme.title: Speciale - Avvocato Ligas

Un bambino di 10 anni scopre di essere l'incarnazione di una divinità, dotato di poteri straordinari e con una missione da predestinato: fermare la sanguinosa guerra che oppone da un secolo la Nazione del Fuoco ai regni di Acqua, Aria e Terra. Adattamento della serie a cartoni "Avatar - la leggenda di Aang", doveva essere il primo film di una trilogia, poi mai realizzata. Formidabile la fotografia di Andrew Lesnie, premio Oscar per "Il signore degli anelli - La compagnia dell'anello".

Quando i giganti, guidati dal perfido Fallon, rapiscono la principessa Isabelle, Jack non esita a unirsi alla truppe che dovranno liberarla, ponendo fine una volta per sempre all'atavica guerra. Spinto dall'amore, supererà le sue paure scoprendo doti e virtù nascoste.
